Figures are in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*: `nvs check` 54.7 M to 41.7 M instructions, an `nvs lsp` open, edit and hover 192.7 M to 48.6 M. Its gap record is deleted.

**14 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red (`bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them). `bun nv scaling --check` was red at the last sweep, so read its output first next session. *Decisions for you* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` has two entries: a total deadline for the request head, and `Markup` concatenation in place.
